svg.title: ART-010 UI Style Base — three directions
svg.desc: Three premium fantasy UI directions derived from the current Arrow-Roguelite playable: Moonlit Bronze, Runeforge, and Enchanted Relic.

g.text: ART-010 · UI STYLE BASE / VISUAL BIBLE v1
Derived from the current playable — moonlit fantasy arena, stone/bronze/wood, warm gold, restrained magic glow, board-first readability.
closest to the live playable · premium magical adventure
blackened stone · worn bronze · smoked crystal · gold focus · violet magic
quiet carved bevel + one warm focus edge
Corners: 8–12px clipped bevels · Type: restrained fantasy serif + clean sans · Glow: only focus / ability / rarity
Motion: 120ms press · 180ms hover lift · 240ms reward pop · no permanent bounce.
rougher Act I energy · iron, copper, leather, ember runes
basalt / iron · hammered copper · leather · ember focus · steel-blue magic
sharper chamfers, fewer curves, more weight
Corners: 45° chamfers · Type: compact fantasy capitals + sturdy sans · Glow: ember grooves / attack urgency
Motion: 90–150ms snap · 2px impact kick · restrained shake for boss / heavy hit only.
warmer exploration tone · carved stone, wood, aged gold, crystal
carved stone · dark wood/leather · aged gold · emerald focus · crystal-violet rarity
softer carved arcs, still weighty and game-like
Corners: 14–18px carved arcs · Type: warmer story serif + clean sans · Glow: soft teal rune halo, rarity violet
Motion: 180–260ms ease-out · slight float on rewards · particles only at reveal / selection.
Shared rule: the board remains visually dominant. UI is opaque enough to read, but never grows into a decorative wall around the puzzle.
